title: Jukola & Venla 2018
text:
We have combined SuffOC/NOR teams travelling out to Finland for this weekend's Jukola & Venla relay races. The Venla, or women's relay, starts at 12:00 BST on Saturday & the Jukola (men's relay) at 21:00 BST. Details of the courses, terrain, maps & results tracking can be found on the Jukola website.

Our team in the womens relay (the Venla) is:
1st leg Chloe Cracknell
2nd Leg Louise Walker
3rd Leg Sally Wilkinson
4th Leg Ella Gilbert

The race starts at 1400 (1200 BST) & our team is number 943 out of 1618

Our Jukola Team for the Open relay is:
1st Leg Tim Harrison
2nd Leg Glen Richardson
3rd Leg Clive Wilkinson
4th Leg Bryn Wilkinson
5th Leg Will Harrison
6th Leg Daniel Cowley
7th Leg Jon Gilbert

The Jukola starts at 2300 (2100 BST) & our team is number 915 out of 1886

We should be able to view the results as they happen & you can also, for a fee, follow the live television coverage.

Good Luck, everyone!
